verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a single marketing mention of an "Área de aprovações" (approvals area) alongside batch payments. That suggests some first-party approval workflow exists, but nothing describes multi-step chains, approver roles, delegation, or escalation. The user and access-profile management API is an adjacent control, not approval routing. Missing for 10: documented multi-step approval chains (manager/budget owner/finance), delegation of approval authority, escalation or timeouts for stalled approvals, configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
